document.title: Pre-Notification for Impending U.S. Domestic Designation and UNSCR 1267 Listing Request of Khalil Haqqani and Said Jan +Abd Al-Salam (State 002648)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Haqqani History: Bin Ladin's Advocate Inside the Taliban
document.note: [Secret] Prior to the September 2012 designation of the Haqqani Network, its leaders had already been added to the UN 1267 list, which carries a travel ban, arms embargo and asset freeze. Named individuals include Jalaluddin Haqqani, his sons Badruddin, Nasiruddin and Sirajuddin, and his brother Khalil Haqqani. Khalil is said to have acted on behalf of al-Qa'ida and, in 2002, deployed men to reinforce AQ elements in Paktia Province.

events.description: State Department cable pre-notifies posts of planned UNSCR 1267 nomination and US domestic designation of Khalil Haqqani and Said Jan Abd Al-Salam
Planned UNSCR 1267 nomination of both men
Planned US designation under E.O. 13224 after the no-objection deadline
Jalaluddin Haqqani added to UN 1267 Consolidated List
Khalil Haqqani had traveled to Dubai and raised funds from sources there and elsewhere
Khalil Haqqani supplied and controlled about 160 combatants in Logar and helped hold prisoners
Khalil Haqqani deployed men to reinforce AQ elements in Paktia
Al-Salam collected donations for al-Qa'ida and the Taliban
Al-Salam transferred funds to a Pakistani extremist group for al-Qa'ida
Al-Salam ran a basic training camp for al-Qa'ida in Pakistan
Al-Salam tasked by an AQ commander to procure weapons, and passed a message to a senior Taliban member
US intends to nominate Khalil Haqqani and Said Jan Abd Al-Salam for UNSCR 1267 listing on or about this date.
US intends to designate both domestically under E.O. 13224 after no-objection deadline.
Jalaluddin Haqqani added to the UN 1267 Consolidated List.
Khalil Haqqani deployed men to reinforce al-Qa'ida in Paktia Province.
Khalil Haqqani had traveled to Dubai and raised funds there and from Saudi Arabia, Iran, China, Pakistan.
Khalil Haqqani supplied and controlled ~160 combatants in Logar.
Khalil Haqqani provided funds to Taliban cells in Logar.
Al-Salam ran a basic training camp for al-Qa'ida in Pakistan.
Al-Salam contacted Taliban-affiliated individuals on al-Qa'ida commander's order.
Al-Salam passed a message from an al-Qa'ida commander to a senior Taliban member; tasked to procure weapons.
Al-Salam collected thousands of dollars in donations for al-Qa'ida and the Taliban.
Al-Salam transferred funds to members of a Pakistani extremist group for al-Qa'ida.
State Department cable pre-notifying governments of the designation and listing requests.

key_claims: Khalil Haqqani is a senior Haqqani Network figure who raises funds internationally (Dubai, Saudi Arabia, Iran, China, Pakistan) for the Taliban and HQN.
Khalil Haqqani funded Taliban cells and commanded about 160 fighters in Logar Province in 2009.
Khalil Haqqani takes operational orders from his nephew Sirajuddin Haqqani and acted on behalf of al-Qa'ida, reinforcing AQ in Paktia in 2002.
Said Jan Abd Al-Salam was a financier and facilitator for al-Qa'ida and the Taliban, including running an AQ basic training camp in Pakistan around 2005.
Said Jan Abd Al-Salam served as an interlocutor between al-Qa'ida commanders and Taliban figures in 2006-2007.
The US planned to nominate both men for UNSCR 1267 listing around 26 Jan 2011 and designate them under E.O. 13224 around 9 Feb 2011.
